comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This 8-item Memorial Album consists of items crafted in relation to Aide Fleet performance. It is both one of the simplest and one of the hardest albums to complete in the game. To start, you need to:

1. Be part of a company that participates in Aide Fleet every month
2. Hope your fleet gains sufficient contribution points

If successful, a recipe will appear at the Company Admin NPC at the end of the Aide Fleet period for one week. With r10 Handicrafts you may craft one of the following ring accessories; they are (by region):

Custom Turquoise Ring - Middle East
Custom Emerald Ring - Africa
Custom Ruby Ring - India
Custom Silver Ring - Latin America
Custom Coral Ring - Oceania
Custom Pearl Ring - Southeast Asia
Custom Golden Ring - East Asia
Custom Gold Ring - North America

That's actually quite easy and could in theory just take eight monthly Aide Fleet deployments. The real challenge comes from the fact that it doesn't seem possible to control where your company deploys its Aide Fleet. Assuming you can complete this Album...

MA Reward: Contribution Coat
Obtained from: Daikokuya Kodayu
St. Petersburg
